title: Relative coherent transfer for cellular enriched weighted cones
statement:
Use quasicategories and coherent parameters of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], complete algebroids of [def-coef-complete-algebroid], the enriched functor calculus of [lem-coef-enriched-category-tensor-calculus], and compatible enriched simplicial presentations of [lem-coef-enriched-simplicial-presentation]. Let $\mathcal V$ be a presentably closed symmetric monoidal infinity-category, $J$ a small simplicial category, and $F,G:J\to\mathscr P$ strict simplicial diagrams in such a presentation. A weight is a simplicial functor $W:J\to\mathsf{sSet}$. Call a weight cellular when it is built from the empty weight by small transfinite compositions of pushouts of coproducts of $J(j,-)\times\partial\Delta^n\to J(j,-)\times\Delta^n$, $n\geq0$; use the same definition starting at $R$ for a relative cellular inclusion $R\hookrightarrow W$.

Suppose enriched functors $h_j:E_{Fj}\to E_{Gj}$ have natural equivalences $G(\alpha)h_j\simeq h_kF(\alpha)$ for arrows $\alpha:j\to k$, with all composition, unit and higher simplicial compatibilities. This means a coherent transformation whose intertwiners are equivalences, rather than equalities of simplicial maps. A coherent map between two such transformations consists of enriched transformations of their components and coherent commutative intertwining squares, including their higher simplices; its components need not be equivalences. Then for a cellular $W$ these data induce an enriched functor between the categories of strict $W$-weighted cones on $F$ and $G$, and coherent maps induce enriched transformations. These categories are the enriched weighted limits when those are formed. The construction retains arbitrary small coherent parameter diagrams, their maps and higher simplices, and coherently respects composition and identities.

For a strict cone $b$, its transferred cone is connected to $h_jb_j$ by the specified coherent equivalences on all components and all cell restrictions. In particular it need not be the literal componentwise composite. These equivalences identify the coherent diagrams of mapping objects, including precomposition and postcomposition maps and every cell-attachment boundary map. Thus natural equivalences between such mapping-object diagrams can be checked on the corresponding unrectified component data.

The transfer has the following relative form. If $R\hookrightarrow W$ is relative cellular and a strict transferred $R$-cone is specified together with a coherent equivalence to the proposed component data on $R$, a strict transferred $W$-cone and a compatible equivalence can be chosen restricting to that $R$-cone. This assertion holds for enriched families of cones and transformations, not merely for their vertices. For a representable $R=J(j,-)$, fixing its cone means fixing its evaluation object; if $R\to W$ is bijective on vertices this fixes all object values forced by strict equivariance. Unit and associative comparisons and their coherence simplices are transferred by the same parameter assertion. None of these conclusions asserts that arbitrary chosen noninvertible intertwiners can replace the specified equivalences.

source.place: Agent-formulated relative enriched transfer lemma using the projective cell/cotensor calculus of sections 5.1--5.3 and the relative walking-module tower in Observation 6.2.4. This general coherent-transformation rectification assertion is a separate foundational obligation, not a theorem quoted verbatim from Riehl--Verity. Archival copy WANTED; no Stacks tag states it.
